queries:
WITH rating_copies AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copies
  FROM film AS f
  LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
mean_copies AS (
  SELECT AVG(copies) AS mean_copies
  FROM rating_copies
)
SELECT
  SUM(rc.copies) AS total_copies,
  AVG(rc.copies - mc.mean_copies) AS average_excess_copies
FROM rating_copies AS rc
CROSS JOIN mean_copies AS mc
WHERE rc.copies > mc.mean_copies

WITH rating_copies AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS copies
  FROM inventory AS i
  JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
mean_copies AS (
  SELECT AVG(copies) AS mean_count
  FROM rating_copies
)
SELECT
  SUM(rc.copies) AS total_copies,
  AVG(100.0 * (rc.copies - mc.mean_count) / mc.mean_count) AS average_percentage_excess
FROM rating_copies AS rc
CROSS JOIN mean_copies AS mc
WHERE rc.copies > mc.mean_count

WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.title) AS title_count
  FROM inventory AS i
  JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
rating_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(title_count) AS mean_title_count
  FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT
  SUM(rc.title_count) AS total_distinct_titles,
  AVG(rc.title_count - rm.mean_title_count) AS average_excess_titles
FROM rating_counts AS rc
CROSS JOIN rating_mean AS rm
WHERE rc.title_count > rm.mean_title_count

WITH title_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.title) AS title_count
  FROM film AS f
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
rating_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(title_count) AS mean_title_count
  FROM title_counts
)
SELECT
  SUM(tc.title_count) AS total_distinct_titles,
  AVG(100.0 * (tc.title_count - rm.mean_title_count) / rm.mean_title_count) AS average_percentage_excess
FROM title_counts AS tc
CROSS JOIN rating_mean AS rm
WHERE tc.title_count > rm.mean_title_count

WITH available_by_rating AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS available_copies
  FROM inventory AS i
  JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM rental AS r
    WHERE r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
      AND r.return_date IS NULL
  )
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
rating_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(available_copies) AS mean_copies
  FROM available_by_rating
)
SELECT SUM(a.available_copies) AS total_available_copies,
       AVG(a.available_copies - m.mean_copies) AS average_excess_copies
FROM available_by_rating AS a
CROSS JOIN rating_mean AS m
WHERE a.available_copies > m.mean_copies

WITH available_by_rating AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS available_copies
  FROM inventory AS i
  JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM rental AS r
    WHERE r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
      AND r.return_date IS NULL
  )
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
rating_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(available_copies) AS mean_copies
  FROM available_by_rating
)
SELECT
  SUM(a.available_copies) AS total_available_copies,
  AVG(100.0 * (a.available_copies - m.mean_copies) / m.mean_copies) AS average_percentage_excess
FROM available_by_rating AS a
CROSS JOIN rating_mean AS m
WHERE a.available_copies > m.mean_copies
